_about: Public-domain John Hurrion (1675?-1731), Independent minister at Hare Court, London, and Merchants' lecturer at Pinners' Hall, for the Word Hoard: The Knowledge of Christ and Him Crucified, The Knowledge of Christ Glorified, The Scripture Doctrine of the Holy Spirit, his occasional sermons, Christ Crucified and Glorified, and a volume of the 1823 Whole Works. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 98 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
